source: Tomkinson GR et al. (iGRIPS). International norms for adult handgrip strength: a systematic review of data on 2.4 million adults aged 20 to 100+ years from 69 countries and regions. J Sport Health Sci 2025;14:101014. Open access, CC BY 4.0. https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11863340/
measure: Hand grip, from the paper's table of absolute handgrip strength percentiles (kg): P5, P20, P50, P80 and P95 for ages 20-24, 25-29, 30-34 and 35-39; the four age groups averaged and converted to lb (x 2.20462)
